questions.stem: This time yesterday I ____ (sit) in the classroom.

options.distractor: “昨天这个时候”强调那一刻正在进行

questions.explanation: this time yesterday 点明过去某个时刻，用 was sitting。

questions.stem: At that time, the children ____ (play) in the garden.

options.distractor: at that time 强调那一刻正在进行

questions.explanation: at that time 提示过去某一刻正在发生，用 were playing。

questions.stem: — What ____ you ____ (do) at eight last night? — I ____ TV.

options.distractor: 问的是昨晚八点那一刻正在做什么

questions.explanation: 问昨晚八点正在做什么，问答都用过去进行时。

questions.stem: He ____ (not sleep) at ten last night. He was still reading.

options.distractor: 这里要表达“十点那一刻没在睡”，用进行时否定

questions.explanation: “昨晚十点没在睡觉”用过去进行时否定 wasn't sleeping。

options.text: She was cooking dinner at six yesterday.
We were having a meeting at that time.
They was watching a film then.
I was walking my dog at that moment.

questions.explanation: they 是复数，be 动词要用 were：They were watching a film then。

questions.stem: I ____ my homework at seven, so I ____ you call me.

options.distractor: 七点那一刻正在做，要用进行时
hear 是感官动词，不用进行时

questions.explanation: 做作业是长动作用 was doing；“没听见”用 didn't hear（hear 不用进行时）。
